_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Tests and Analyses Reports, Vibration, Reciprocating Machinery, Propulsion System and Shafting
summary: Specifies the format and content preparation instructions for vibration test and mathematical analysis reports on reciprocating machinery, propulsion systems, and shafting to verify compliance with acceptance criteria.
description_purpose: 3.1 These data are to be used to determine if excessive vibratory responses exist within the system under consideration. A mathematical analysis is performed to establish probable compliance with the prescribed acceptance criteria. The system is tested to confirm that the vibratory responses are within the acceptable criteria.
application_interrelationship:
7.1 This Data Item Description contains the format and content preparation instructions for vibration testing and analysis of reciprocating machinery, propulsion system and shafting to be conducted in accordance with MIL-STD-167-2A.
7.2 This DID supersedes UDI-E-23116A.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall be in accordance with the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content Requirements.
preparation_instructions.content: The reports shall include the following:

children.title: The vibration analysis shall consist of items stated in paragraphs 30.1.1.1, 30.2.1.1 and 30.3.1 of MIL-STD-167-2A, Appendix A.
The results of vibration testing shall be included and shall consist of items specified in paragraphs 30.1 and 30.2 of MIL-STD-167-2A, Appendix B.
Vibratory stress, torque, load and deflection plots shall be included and shall contain the appropriate MIL-STD-167-2A limits, or the manufacturer's limits, as applicable.
